title: The New Class
author: Milovan Đilas
current_text: Milovan Đilas was tried over The New Class, charged with being “hostile to the people and the state of Yugoslavia,” and given a seven-year sentence.

sources.quote: The New Class placed Djilas in the dock once again. This time he was charged with being "hostile to the people and the state of Yugoslavia," for which he received a seven-year sentence.
sources.title: Letters From Prison: Milovan Djilas

sources.quote: The New Class resulted in another trial and seven-year sentence for “being hostile to the people and the state of Yugoslavia.” In 1962, Djilas published Conversations with Stalin, which resulted in another prison term.
sources.title: Hoover Acquires Milovan Djilas Literary Archives | Hoover Institution
